capabilities: Track initiative, HP, AC, and status conditions for creatures in encounters
Calculate encounter difficulty and XP by level or challenge rating
Group identical creatures with pooled HP and shared initiative
Save and load encounters in encounter code blocks
Integrate with Fantasy Statblocks bestiaries and Dice Roller rolls
extras: Warning not to install alongside the original initiative-tracker plugin (same functionality, different plugin ID). Licensed GNU GPL v3. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A community fork of Initiative Tracker for Obsidian
motivation: The README says this fork is maintained independently and includes community enhancements on top of the original plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run combat encounters, so DMs must track initiative, HP, and conditions outside their notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of Initiative Tracker by Jeremy Valentine.
Fantasy Statblocks — statblocks and bestiary integration

summary: Combat tracker for TTRPG encounters that tracks initiative, HP, AC, conditions, and XP in encounter code blocks.
